summary: Answer strict exact RFI/Submittal Subject questions from existing local primary-form evidence before model dispatch.
decision_refs: The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files
CIRP already has one evidence-grounded Ask the project flow and a complete cached workflow index
Exact Subject questions can safely reuse those local structures without a second chat service or provider request
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency and accuracy improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Only strict English direct-question forms naming one exact RFI or Submittal use the local shortcut.
Only explicit line-leading Subject fields in existing non-vision primary-form evidence qualify; semantic topics and Email Subject headers do not.
The shortcut checks at most 32 primary documents and 512 Subject-bearing passages and fails closed above either bound.
No supported value falls through to ordinary grounded Q&A; the shortcut does not infer applicability, status, revision, authority, precedence or semantic equivalence.
